Another Home

Download Now



please wiƨhlist another home (diorama) on  STEAM!!! it'll have many qol changes and includes pretty much everything you've been suggesting these months, i hope you'll like it!!!

No goals, just head empty and just decorate~




Since this is still slightly lacking on a few essential furniture, i’m constantly adding new furniture and other placeables on a monthly bases to make up for it~

You’re welcome to use made homes for any projects~!!

Feel free to share screenshots of your builds down in the comments!!


[Controls]

.·:*¨    ¨*:·.

[E]toggle edit mode~
[Left Mouse Button] place object~
[Right Mouse Button]flip object~
[WASD / ARROW KEYS]move around your diorama~
[X]delete hovered object~ (hold to delete multiple!)
[ESC] save, load and manage your dioramas~

[Advanced Controls]

.·:*¨    ¨*:·.

[F4] take and save screenshot~
[UP / DOWN]while selected, move stuff in front or below others~
[CONTROL / I]clone/eyepick hovered object~
[SHIFT]hold shift to increase the camera speed ~

(retrospectively looking  at these makes me realise how unbelievably clunky these controls are but this has been my first game ever so don't  judge >:c...)e
